limitations: Internal engineering review, not independent expert certification.
Ideal insulated lumped-enthalpy model with chosen constant properties, not calibrated calorimetry.
No heat loss, gradients, apparatus heat capacity, supercooling, evaporation or pressure effects.
Reference densities set phase volumes; rack displacement and schematic drip transit mass are neglected.
Supported domain stays below 4 °C; boiling is not modelled.
Manual playback compresses time 15×; the guide stages timing; recorded time is model time.
